summary.text: Mark Cooper is a Republican state representative from Maine House District 107, in office since December 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Joseph Campbell. He owns a building contracting company.

paragraphs.text: Cooper graduated from Windham High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 1983.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning a building contracting company and notes his affiliations with the Cumberland Farmers Club, the Maine Maple Producers Association and the 4-H Club.
He took office on December 3, 2024, succeeding Jane Pringle.
